card.name: Spots where 'sometimes' or 'at times' comes next
card.fires_on: Punctuation, 'at', or a linking word right before 'sometimes', 'at times' or 'often' in general web prose. It marks a point where a frequency adverb is expected next.

modes.label: Inside 'at times'
modes.description: The word 'at' in 'at times' after an adjective and 'and'.
modes.example: Due to his rambunctious and<< at>> times rebellious nature as a youth,

modes.label: Before a frequency adverb
modes.description: A period, comma or 'but' just before 'sometimes' starts the next clause.
modes.example: But he played to packed houses<<,>> sometimes over a thousand people at a time

modes.label: Auxiliary before 'at times'
modes.description: A verb such as 'has' placed just before 'at times'.
modes.example: record on anti-Semitism<< has>> at times fallen short of our ideals.

card.writes: It raises words like 'sometimes' and 'often' and lowers 'likely' and 'probably'.
card.plain: It fires where the text is about to say 'sometimes' or 'at times'.
